'''Nigel Lincoln''' is a Star Wars CCG player who finished 15th at [[March 2001 Hatfield tournament]] on 18 March 2001 with [[Rescue The Princess / Sometimes I Amaze Even Myself|Rescue The Princess]], according to Jamie Giberti's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1942">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-03-24-hatfield-england-3-18-2k1d1942/ hatfield-england-3-18-2k1], DeckTech (Jamie "JEEBS" Giberti, 24 March 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-03-24-hatfield-england-3-18-2k1d1942/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
